name: Polar Wire Products
old_description: We are a renowned manufacturer of premium industrial-grade wire designed to withstand even the harshest environments. Our finely stranded wire configurations are proudly made in the USA and used among a variety of applications from recreational equipment to the development of the latest revolutionary technology.
about:
Polar Wire Products was founded in 1991 in Anchorage, Alaska, as a family-owned business. From its humble beginnings in Alaska, the company expanded to key locations in the lower 48 states while maintaining its headquarters and manufacturing in Anchorage.

The company manufactures premium industrial-grade wire, most notably its flagship Arctic Ultraflex Blue® and Arctic Superflex Blue® lines, which are rated for continuous operation from -55°C to 105°C and use 100% copper conductors with no aluminum. In addition to wire manufacturing, Polar Wire provides custom cable assembly services built to IPC/WHMA-A-620 Class 3 standards, wholesale distribution of solderless terminals, compression and mechanical lugs, heat shrink, and other wiring control products and tools. Its facilities offer engineering services and technical review, precision cutting and stripping, and high-quality crimping, with capacity ranging from rapid prototyping to large-scale production. Thousands of fittings and products are stocked for quick turnaround.

Polar Wire serves a broad customer base that includes the general public, government agencies, OEMs, stocking distributors, and fleet accounts. Its products are used in renewable energy, telecommunications, automotive, fleet, commercial, industrial, and recreational applications. Finished assemblies appear as battery cables, jumper cables, extension cords, shore power and generator leads, and stage and lighting cords.

The company emphasizes its hands-on control of every stage from design to assembly, citing superior quality, exceptional customer service, and competitive pricing as differentiators. Its wire has been proven in extreme environments from Alaska's North Slope to Antarctica, and the team carries over 200 years of combined industry experience. Polar Wire aims for long-term, mutually beneficial partnerships and offers private-label/OEM manufacturing with custom configurations, colors, striping, and print legends.
